An Earth Jukebox project description that is concise, engaging, and ready to upload for a portfolio, science fair, or exhibition:

Project Title: Earth Jukebox: Listening to the Planet’s Climate

Short Description

Earth Jukebox is an interactive web-based project that lets users experience global climate data through sound. By selecting a temperature setting and clicking on different regions of an interactive globe, visitors can listen to ambient soundscapes and musical compositions dynamically generated or filtered based on that area's climate conditions. It bridges data visualization and interactive art to make the impact of temperature changes on diverse global ecosystems more immersive and memorable.
